details.s: Frodo Baggins was a Hobbit of The Shire in the late Third Age. He was a key figure in the Quest of Mount Doom, in which he bore the One Ring to Mount Doom, where it was destroyed. He was a Ring-bearer, best friend to his gardener, Samwise Gamgee, and was one of three hobbits who sailed from Middle-earth to the Uttermost West at the end of the Third Age.
f: Bearer of the One Ring, Elf-friend, Deputy Mayor of Michel Delving
Frodo of the Nine Fingers, Nine-Fingered Frodo, Maura Labingi (Westron name), Mr. Underhill, Sneaky hobbit (by Gollum)
